def process_host(self, host_spec, name, line_idx=0):
        """
        One host spec processing
        :param host_spec:
        :param name:
        :param line_idx:
        :return:
        """
        if not host_spec:
            return
        # Add a new host
        host = self.hosts.add_host(name)
        if host is None:
            self.error_msg("host {} already defined, line {}".format(name, line_idx))
            return
        # Parse host attributes
        self.parse_host_attrs(host, host_spec)
        # Add host to groups
        for group_name in self.group_names:
            group = self.groups.get_group(group_name)
            if group is None:
                self.error_msg("group {} not found in line {}".format(group_name, line_idx))
                return
            group.add_host(host)
